jobs.title: Data Annotation
responsibilities: Review project guidelines and understand annotation rules before starting production work.
Label, classify, tag or validate structured and unstructured data accurately.
Identify unclear examples and escalate edge cases for reviewer guidance.
Maintain consistent quality across assigned batches and complete corrections when requested.
Follow confidentiality, data-handling and project-specific quality requirements.

jobs.title: Data Collection
responsibilities: Collect project-specific text, image, audio, video or other requested data according to instructions.
Verify that submitted samples meet format, quality and diversity requirements.
Record required metadata accurately and avoid duplicate or invalid submissions.
Follow consent, privacy and data-collection guidelines provided for each project.
Respond to quality feedback and replace rejected samples when needed.

jobs.title: RLHF / LLM Evaluation
responsibilities: Compare AI-generated responses and select the stronger answer using project guidelines.
Evaluate helpfulness, correctness, relevance, reasoning quality and instruction following.
Write concise justifications when a task requires ranking or reviewer comments.
Identify unsafe, misleading or low-quality model behavior and classify it correctly.
Maintain consistent judgment across repeated evaluation tasks and calibration reviews.

jobs.title: Image Labeling
responsibilities: Label objects and attributes in images using bounding boxes, polygons, segmentation or classification tools.
Apply class labels consistently according to taxonomy and annotation guidelines.
Check object boundaries, occlusion, visibility and difficult edge cases carefully.
Review completed annotations for missing objects and incorrect labels before submission.
Complete reviewer corrections and follow updated guidelines during project calibration.

jobs.title: Video Annotation
responsibilities: Annotate objects, actions, events or scenes across video frames according to project guidelines.
Track objects consistently across frames and maintain stable labels through movement and occlusion.
Mark frame ranges, timestamps, key events or activity segments when required.
Review video sequences for missed labels, ID switches and inconsistent annotations.
Apply reviewer feedback and maintain accuracy across long or complex sequences.
